name: Milk
overview: Scripture uses milk both literally and figuratively to illustrate God's provision and blessings. The land promised to Israel is described as flowing with milk and honey, symbolizing abundance and divine favor (Exodus 3:8, 3:17, 13:5). Milk, along with butter and other dairy products, was a valued part of the diet in biblical times, as seen in Genesis 18:8 and Genesis 32:15. Additionally, milk represents the foundational teachings of the gospel, nourishing believers as they grow in faith.
